charlie noiir.bio: Toronto rapper and vocalist Charlie Noiir is a Canadian hip-hop artist known for his solo work and as a member of the STAYOUTLATE collective. Earlier in his career he fronted the Toronto duo OSIYM, later developing a melodic, genre-fluid solo catalogue while remaining closely tied to the city's independent rap scene.

dj ritz.bio: DJ Ritz is a Toronto DJ, radio personality and producer who has been part of the city's urban music scene for more than two decades. A former Toronto DJ of the Year winner, he also hosts Made In Canada on FLOW 98.7FM, a program devoted to Canadian artists.

jordan fall.bio: Jordan Fall is a Filipino-Canadian rapper, singer and DJ from Toronto whose music blends hip-hop, R&B and electronic influences. After first becoming known behind the decks in Toronto's IXXI circle, including work with Sean Leon, he moved into a solo recording career with releases such as Savings, Good Mourning and Truss.

sully burrows.bio: Parry Sound singer-songwriter Sully Burrows is a Canadian country artist whose small-town Ontario roots shape his contemporary country sound. He emerged with songs including Youth, Think of Me and Rally Around, later becoming a SiriusXM Top of the Country finalist and a CMAOntario Emerging Artist Award winner.

chudi harris.bio: Halifax singer-songwriter and recording artist Chudi Harris is part of Nova Scotia's independent R&B and hip-hop community. His alternative R&B catalogue includes multiple EPs and collaborations, with performances and recordings connecting him to artists including Aquakultre, T. Thomason, Ghettosocks and Tachichi.

jimmie d.bio: Jimmie D is a Canadian hip-hop artist from Montreal's St-Henri neighbourhood whose understated, bar-heavy style has become closely associated with producer Nicholas Craven. Their long-running partnership includes projects such as Trout & Brussels Sprouts, Good Man and Good Music Hypnotizes, alongside collaborations with other Canadian underground rappers.
